title: Image Dithering
summary: A dithering image filter with support for 4 dithering modes and multiple color palettes (2-color, 3-color, and multicolor options, using either predefined colors or colors sampled from the original im

params.name: fit
params.description: How to fit the rendered shader into the canvas dimensions (0 = none, 1 = contain, 2 = cover)

params.name: colorHighlight
params.description: Secondary foreground color in RGBA (set same as colorFront for classic 2-color dithering), needs originalColors off

params.name: colorSteps
params.description: Number of colors to use, applies to both color modes

params.name: originalColors
params.description: Use the original colors of the image instead of the color palette

params.name: inverted
params.description: Inverts the image luminance, doesn't affect the color scheme

notes: Uses an image (installed to brand/assets/materials/); swap `image` for your own picture or texture.
Breathes on `size` from 2 to 4 so a still shader stays alive.
